style: Illustration for an announcement image of Zolva, an app whose trading agents explain every decision, now readable by AI assistants through an MCP server. Glossy soft clay-like 3D render, smooth rounded forms, soft studio light from the top left, palette of lavender #9896ff, violet #6a5ef5, pale lilac #e9e8ff, deep ink #252228 and small warm yellow #ffc42c accents, crisp white highlights. Background is a soft blurred lavender and violet colour field. Keep the left 40% of the image calm and nearly empty for a headline added later; the subject sits in the right 60%. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no people.

icons.p18-plug: Subject: a big chunky glossy plug connecting two things with a thick lavender cable: on one side a rounded white AI chat bubble with three dots, on the other a neat floating stack of small white agent cards, each with a tiny rising or falling line chart and a small round buy or sell badge. A soft glow where the plug meets the socket.
icons.p18-switchboard: Subject: one glossy lavender orb in the middle, like a hub, with many thin glowing light cables arcing out to floating rounded app icons around it: a chat bubble, a cursor arrow, a terminal window with a blinking block, a small robot head with a dark visor. Small light particles travel along the cables toward the icons. Feels like a friendly 3D telephone switchboard.
icons.p18-glass-tower: Subject: a tall transparent glass tower made of stacked rounded glass cards, each card holding a small coloured arrow: green up, red down or a grey pause bar, like a log of trading decisions. A small friendly rounded robot with a dark visor stands beside it holding a big magnifying glass up to the cards, reading them. Soft reflections and refractions in the glass.

note: P18 (Public API and MCP) illustration concepts, 2026-11-06, low quality, about $0.05 for 3. Run: PROMPTS=assets/p18-mcp-prompts.json OUT_DIR=assets/brand/banner-v4 node scripts/generate-icons.mjs
